trial_title: Non-invasive Neurostimulation of the Vagus Nerve for the Treatment of Cluster Headache
brief_summary: Multi-center, prospective, double-blind, randomized, sham-controlled pivotal study of non-invasive vagus nerve stimulation with the GammaCore® device for the acute treatment of cluster headache. The study compares the safety and effectiveness of an active treatment (GammaCore) against a sham treatment.

eligibility_table.justification: The patient has not been diagnosed with cluster headache, but rather with spontaneous intraventricular hemorrhage and arteriovenous malformation.
